range_interpretation.disclosure_UNVERIFIED: The source library holds 108 cards, not 96, so '61-72 of 96' is under-determined and the mapping from a 96-slot plan onto a 108-card library is UNVERIFIED. Linear card index is the mapping chosen and is stated here so the orchestrator can detect an overlap or a gap against sibling units mechanically instead of discovering one silently. validator_result.driver_wraps: platform/lib/wfdsl/validate.py::validate_workflow - the same function the `workflow` subcommand calls
defects_the_validator_caught_during_auth: lineage relation 'ADOPT' is not in the disposition enum (must be ADOPT-AS-IS)
estimate confidence 'very-likely' is not in the confidence_band enum
the expression grammar has NO arithmetic: 'recovered + recovered_partial + lost == n' does not parse, so the accounting sum is computed by the emitting unit and the gate compares the published total

mechanism_distinctness.method: structural fingerprint (stage-kind multiset, fan-out source and concurrency band, barrier mode and partial policy, convergence disposition and metrics, gate predicate and metric tokens, stopping dispositions, retry and failure policy, replay and cache posture, declared mechanism primary, output schemas) compared pairwise by Jaccard. Prose is deliberately excluded.

both_states_control.kind: synthetic prose-only copy of one blueprint
both_states_control.note: A detector silent on an exact copy measures nothing, so a silent control is a FAILURE of the script rather than a pass for the corpus.

merge_and_split_actions.merge_rationale: The measured maximum pairwise mechanism similarity is 0.2308 against a 0.85 threshold, and no two blueprints share a declared mechanism primary, so no merge was warranted. Reporting a merge that the detector does not support would be manufactured coverage.
merge_and_split_actions.split_detail: BP-SEC-01 fuses two mechanisms with different failure modes - repairing findings, and certifying that the instrument producing findings can produce them at all. Split into security-review-scanner-fix-loop.json (the fix loop) and scanner-detector-integrity-probe.json (the both-states instrument control), wired as a real subworkflow reference so the control can be run on its own before any scan.

tests.command: cd platform/lib && python -m pytest workflows/test_<13 modules>.py workflows/test_bp6_corpus.py -q
tests.both_states_controls: every mechanism assertion is paired with a mutation control that must FAIL on a document with that mechanism removed; the mutation helper refuses a no-op edit so a control cannot silently assert against the pristine document
self_caught_defects: the first draft of a control repaired the dependency it had just broken, so DSL-SEM-002 could not fire and the control proved nothing - the test failed and was rewritten

a control asserted a stage id would appear in a semantic-violation message; the messages are JSON-pointer keyed, so the stage identity is now confirmed from the document and the pointer index is asserted instead
extra_checks_beyond_the_dsl_validator: every inline work unit validates against work-unit.normative AND work-unit.strict, not only the structural profile the DSL requires
every inline unit's completion_sentinel names its own id - SEM-002 only runs over a CATALOG, so a unit inlined in a DSL stage otherwise gets no sentinel check from either side

every schema_ref / output_schema in all 13 blueprints resolves to a file on disk and compiles as draft 2020-12 (35 distinct references, 0 missing - counted, after a first draft of this artifact wrote 67 from memory and was corrected by the count)

worked-example conformance: required params bound, no undeclared params, enum and range and pattern respected, every top-level stage either walked or explicitly skipped with a reason, every expected artifact declared by some stage or output, terminal sentinel names a real inline unit

honest_negatives: No blueprint in this range declares a `council` stage. Not one of cards 61-72 specifies a deliberative council topology - they are security reviews, incident procedures and a routing rule whose participant topologies are parallel probes plus a reconciler plus an owner checkpoint. Adding a council to tick a capability box would be padding; the absence is asserted by a test rather than left ambiguous.
No blueprint declares a standalone `barrier` stage; barriers here ride their fan-out through barrier_spec. Also asserted, so the claim is measured.

Two blueprints declare replay as NON-deterministic on purpose (the supply-chain campaign, because advisory data is time-varying and the snapshot date is the record; the incident triage, because a live-system probe cannot be replayed byte-exactly). Claiming determinism there would be decorative.

The worked examples are DESIGNED walkthroughs with concrete parameter bindings and expected artifacts, checked mechanically against the definitions. They are NOT recorded runs: no blueprint in this set has been EXECUTED end to end, because no runner exists yet. Settling experiment: once a runner lands, replay each worked example and compare the produced artifact set against expected_artifacts.
scope_notes: Nothing outside platform/workflows/ and platform/lib/workflows/ was modified. No git operation was performed.

platform/lib/workflows/ is shared with sibling units; conftest.py there is a sibling's and was reused unchanged. An empty __init__.py added by this unit was removed again because turning that directory into a package would change pytest's module-naming semantics for every sibling test file in it.
